\[
W = \begin{bmatrix}
  20 & 20 & 200 \\
  20 & 20 & 200 \\
  20 & 20 & 200
\end{bmatrix}
\]

The window lies on a vertical edge, dark on the left and bright on the right.

| Output | Value |
|---|---|
| R1 | -180 |
| R2 | 180 |
| Magnitude (L2) | 254.56 |

R1 is the center 20 minus the pixel below right, 200, which is -180. R2 is the right neighbor 200 minus the pixel below, 20, which is 180.
